exhibits.label: PUSH DOOR
exhibits.about: a z-motion door opened by pushing its own wall
exhibits.try: walk up to it and press use on the door face

exhibits.label: SWITCHED DOOR
exhibits.about: the same door, worked from a switch across the stall
exhibits.try: press the switch on the side wall, not the door

exhibits.label: KEYED DOOR
exhibits.about: a door with a key emblem; the key lies in the stall
exhibits.try: try the door first, then take the key and try again
exhibits.provenance: doors.KEY_TYPES + knowledge/blood/design/keys-v1.json; E1M4 sector 295 wears the moon emblem

exhibits.label: LIFT
exhibits.about: a floor that carries a body between two standing levels
exhibits.try: ride it up, then step off and look down

exhibits.label: CRACK BARRIER
exhibits.about: a wall that opens once, when shot, and never closes
exhibits.try: shoot the crack; the way behind it stays open

exhibits.label: TURNSTILE PAIR
exhibits.about: two counter-rotating four-vane rotors, E1M4's spin rate
exhibits.try: WALK THROUGH IT. this settles the parked passage question

exhibits.label: TURNSTILE SAME WAY
exhibits.about: the DNE3L6 variant: both rotors turning the same way
exhibits.try: walk through and compare with the pair next door

exhibits.label: SLIDING GATE
exhibits.about: a gate that slides rather than turning
exhibits.try: watch which way it goes and try to follow it

exhibits.label: CASKET
exhibits.about: the player start as a mechanism: slide, stack link and z at once
exhibits.try: look up, then walk out; this is E1M1's opening shot
exhibits.provenance: owner-attested E1M1 reading, sectors 30 and 28, stack link 10; roadmap Phase 8 note

exhibits.label: DOUBLE SLIDE DOOR
exhibits.about: one sector carrying both leaves, parting in opposite directions
exhibits.try: stand in the middle and watch both halves go

exhibits.label: DOUBLE ROTATE DOOR
exhibits.about: two rotating leaves chained by channel, one firing the next
exhibits.try: press once and watch the second leaf follow
exhibits.provenance: owner-attested E1M1 reading, sectors 50 and 51 (rx 105 -> tx 106 -> rx 106)

exhibits.label: CURTAIN
exhibits.about: a slide used as furnishing rather than as a way through
exhibits.try: open it; nothing beyond it was closed off
exhibits.provenance: owner-attested E1M1 reading, sector 125. Its tile has no owner binding, which is why the dressing plane cannot name it -- reports/blood-role-v2.md

exhibits.label: SHELF SECRET
exhibits.about: a shelf that slides aside and is a secret entrance
exhibits.try: find what opens it, then look behind the shelf

exhibits.label: STACK LINK
exhibits.about: room over room: two floors in one place
exhibits.try: walk the lower floor, then the upper, and look down
exhibits.provenance: reachability.link_pairs; owner note on the ROR visibility budget -- two volumes must not be in view at once
exhibits.blocker: NEEDS A SECOND ROR VOLUME OUT OF SIGHT OF THE CASKET

exhibits.label: FACADE NARROW
exhibits.about: a street frontage at its narrow width, with its lettered sign
exhibits.try: stand back in the corridor and read the sign

exhibits.label: FACADE WIDE
exhibits.about: the same grammar at the wide width
exhibits.try: compare the bay rhythm with the narrow one

exhibits.label: DRESSED DOORWAY
exhibits.about: a doorway wearing jamb rail and threshold
exhibits.try: look down at the threshold and along the jambs

exhibits.label: COUNTER
exhibits.about: a counter with the working clearance behind it
exhibits.try: try to stand behind the counter; the gap is measured

exhibits.label: CRATE STACK
exhibits.about: crates built from the owner's tiles: intact, broken, large
exhibits.try: check these are crates and not mossy rocks
exhibits.provenance: owner anchors 452 / 462 / 95; a build once shipped tile 459, a moss-grown rock, as a crate

exhibits.label: SHELF RUN
exhibits.about: a run of wall shelves, the owner's strong-binding tile
exhibits.try: look along the run; the tile is 2026

exhibits.label: MANNEQUIN ROW
exhibits.about: three mannequins in a display row
exhibits.try: the tile binds its meaning almost always -- does it here

exhibits.label: PARK CORNER
exhibits.about: grass and dirt with trees
exhibits.try: walk the grass and look at where it meets the dirt
exhibits.provenance: owner anchors 361 (grass, strong) and 270 (dirt); furniture.py park vocabulary

exhibits.label: SEWER WALL
exhibits.about: the sewer kit: pipe walls and a technical door
exhibits.try: look for the seam between the pipe run and the door

exhibits.label: TILE MUSEUM
exhibits.about: the owner's strong-binding tiles, each with its name
exhibits.try: read the names and correct any that are wrong
